files.content:
main:
  URI: "ws://127.0.0.1:6700"
  token: "111"
  #机器人掉线自动重连间隔
  auto_reconnect: 1
#开启后机器人会实时输出websocket通讯
debug: false
#debug消息最大长度
debug_message_max_length: 1000
#机器人主人列表
owners:
  - '000000'
command_prefix: "sudo"
messages:
  log_command: "&aQQ用户: %user% 执行了 %cmd% 命令"

name: AmazingBot
version: '5.0.2'
main: me.albert.amazingbot.AmazingBot
api-version: '1.13'
folia-supported: true
commands:
  amazingbot:
    permission: amazingbot.admin
softdepend:
  - MCKotlin-Paper
  - CoreLib
